lessons_used: Predictions continue to be consistently too high compared to measured and noise-corrected results.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +2.2% after noise correction across 2 tests, with 1 test winning.
Evidence is still thin for adding new adoption screens (adoption, new_screen) with only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.

candidates.title: Account pet restore reassurance hint
candidates.change: Add a clear explanatory hint on the sign-in screen informing users that logging in saves and syncs their adopted pets safely to their account.
candidates.why: 8 support emails mentioned pets missing or reset after signing in again, causing confusion around account sync.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically saves and syncs your pet across all your devices.

guard.reason: Adds a clear reassurance hint on the sign-in screen without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 8 support emails regarding sign-in account sync with a low-cost hint.

candidates.title: Desktop pet readiness checklist
candidates.change: Insert a new setup checklist screen before waiting to confirm desktop display permissions and overlay readiness.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pet not displaying on desktop or app failing to open, while the home step has long wait times (median 201s).

new_desktop_check.headline: Desktop Setup Check
new_desktop_check.body: Confirming desktop overlay permissions so your pet can roam freely on your screen.

guard.reason: Adds a valid setup checklist screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: New screens have weak evidence from past tests and require full release.

candidates.title: Compact welcome banner with quick start guide
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro screen into a compact banner highlighting simple desktop pet controls and quick tips.
candidates.why: Support emails showed post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide pets, and the finish step drop-off is 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Click your pet anytime to bring up controls, hide it, or start chatting.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro into a compact banner layout while keeping its core function.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has a large 35.2% drop-off; compact guide helps post-onboarding confusion.

candidates.title: Photo upload sample guidance
candidates.change: Add hint text on the photo upload screen explaining best lighting and photo angles for pet creation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets mentioned custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption step drop-off is high (60.9%).

upload_photos.hint: For best pet generation results, upload well-lit photos with simple backgrounds.

guard.reason: Adds helpful guidance hint text to the photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Adoption loses 39.1% of users; simple photo guidance hint is config-only.

candidates.title: Spotlight waiting screen with animated mascot tips
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a spotlight layout featuring interactive tip carousels during pet generation.
candidates.why: Waiting step median duration is 201s (mean 2336s); engaging users during processing helps reduce drop-offs.

components.text: Did you know? You can drag your pet anywhere on your screen!

guard.reason: Redesigns the waiting screen with a spotlight layout and tip carousel while maintaining its function.

candidates.score_note: Engaging users during 201s wait helps drop-offs, but screen redesign costs high effort.

candidates.title: Story scroll onboarding introduction
candidates.change: Rebuild the story screen into a story_scroll layout introducing the concept of desktop companions before path selection.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path screen with a mean time of 514s, indicating initial hesitation or lack of context.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop World
story.body: Discover how your pet lives, plays, and stays right on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigns the story screen to a scroll layout while continuing to introduce the pet.

candidates.score_note: Rebuilding story flow is expensive with unproven lift for new screen flows.

candidates.title: Cloud sync benefit callout badge
candidates.change: Add a prominent highlight badge on the sign-in screen emphasizing cloud backup protection.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or lost pets after re-login, which can be mitigated by highlighting account save benefits.

components.text: Cloud Save: Keep your pet profile safe across updates

guard.reason: Adds a cloud save benefit badge on the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: High support email volume (8) backed by sign-in drop-off, very low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Certificate preview before photo upload
candidates.change: Reorder adoption step screens so users preview the adoption certificate before uploading custom photos.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is 60.9%; previewing the adoption certificate earlier builds user commitment before photo upload effort.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Ready notification toggle on intro
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification options on home_intro so users are notified as soon as their pet finishes loading.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted that the pet failed to appear or users did not realize the app was active on screen.

home_intro.hint: We'll notify you as soon as your pet lands on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adds notification options to home_intro within onboarding boundaries.

candidates.score_note: Addresses finish drop-off and support tickets about active app awareness.

candidates.title: Two-column path selection layout
candidates.change: Update choose_path layout to two_column to display adoption options cleanly side-by-side.
candidates.why: choose_path has a high mean decision time of 514s; side-by-side presentation simplifies decision-making.

choose_path.headline: Choose How You Want to Adopt Your Pet

guard.reason: Updates choose_path layout to two-column format while preserving path options.

candidates.score_note: Helps high decision time (514s) at choose_path via cleaner layout.

picked: Compact welcome banner with quick start guide
held_by_harm_budget: Spotlight waiting screen with animated mascot tips
